headline: Resting heart rate is a little above your usual range.

suggested_actions.text: Recheck after a few minutes of quiet rest.
Note any recent exertion or stimulant use.

contact_ground_text: Contact ground if it stays higher than usual or you feel unwell.

headline: Resting heart rate is elevated above your usual range.

suggested_actions.text: Rest and rehydrate.
Recheck in a calm setting.

contact_ground_text: Contact ground if it remains elevated or other symptoms appear.

headline: Resting heart rate is very high.

suggested_actions.text: Stop strenuous activity and sit quietly.
Check the sensor placement.

contact_ground_text: Contact ground now, or as soon as the communications link allows. In a blackout, log it and add it to the relay summary.

headline: Resting heart rate has been creeping up over time.

suggested_actions.text: Schedule protected recovery time.
Review recent workload and sleep.

contact_ground_text: Contact ground to review the trend, or log it for the relay summary during a blackout.

headline: Sleep duration is a little low.

suggested_actions.text: Extend your wind-down routine.
Keep the sleep area dark and quiet.

contact_ground_text: Contact ground if sleep stays short for more than a couple of nights.

headline: Sleep duration is low enough to affect alertness.

suggested_actions.text: Ask about adjusting the light schedule.
Protect sleep time in the schedule.

contact_ground_text: Contact ground soon to review sleep countermeasures.

headline: Sleep is very short and may affect performance and health.

suggested_actions.text: Ask for help prioritizing sleep.
Minimize light and noise during sleep time.

contact_ground_text: Contact ground now, or as soon as the communications link allows. If you are in a blackout, log it for the relay summary.

headline: Sleep duration has been trending down.

suggested_actions.text: Review the sleep schedule with the crew.
Track what changes before short-sleep nights.

contact_ground_text: Contact ground to discuss the trend, or add it to the relay summary during a blackout.

headline: Body temperature is a little above your usual range.

suggested_actions.text: Rest and rehydrate.
Recheck after cooling down.

contact_ground_text: Contact ground if it stays above your usual range or you feel unwell.

headline: Body temperature is elevated above your usual range.

suggested_actions.text: Move to a cooler area if possible.
Recheck using the same sensor after rest.

contact_ground_text: Contact ground soon to report the reading and any symptoms.

headline: Body temperature is very high.

suggested_actions.text: Stop exertion and cool down if possible.
Verify the sensor is attached correctly.

contact_ground_text: Contact ground now, or as soon as the communications link allows. In a blackout, log it and add to the relay summary.

headline: Body temperature has been drifting upward.

suggested_actions.text: Check the sensor and environment.
Schedule a recheck at the same time each day.

contact_ground_text: Contact ground to review the trend, or log it for the relay summary during a blackout.

headline: Mood and stress score is a little low.

suggested_actions.text: Take a short break and talk with a crewmate.
Note what is stressing you most.

contact_ground_text: Contact ground if low mood lasts or worsens.

headline: Mood and stress score is low.

suggested_actions.text: Use a scheduled countermeasure such as a mindfulness or exercise block.
Reach out to a crewmate.

contact_ground_text: Contact ground soon to discuss support options.

headline: Mood and stress score is very low.

suggested_actions.text: Ask a crewmate to stay nearby.
Pause non-essential demands if the schedule allows.

contact_ground_text: Contact ground now, or as soon as the communications link allows. In a blackout, log it for the relay summary.

headline: Mood and stress score has been trending down.

suggested_actions.text: Plan a social or leisure activity with the crew.
Review workload and sleep patterns.

contact_ground_text: Contact ground to review the trend, or add it to the relay summary during a blackout.

headline: Exercise time is a little below target.

suggested_actions.text: Add a short movement block to the schedule.
Check equipment availability.

contact_ground_text: Contact ground if exercise stays low for several days.

headline: Exercise time is below target.

suggested_actions.text: Prioritize the next scheduled exercise session.
Discuss alternative exercises with ground.

contact_ground_text: Contact ground soon to adjust the countermeasure plan.

headline: Exercise time is far below target.

suggested_actions.text: Contact ground to revise the exercise plan.
Assess whether equipment or health is blocking exercise.

contact_ground_text: Contact ground now, or as soon as the communications link allows. In a blackout, log it and add to the relay summary.

headline: Exercise time has been trending down.

suggested_actions.text: Schedule a crew exercise session.
Review barriers to daily exercise.

contact_ground_text: Contact ground to review the trend, or add it to the relay summary during a blackout.

headline: Blood oxygen is a little below the usual range.

suggested_actions.text: Check sensor placement and recheck.
Rest quietly and recheck.

contact_ground_text: Contact ground if the reading stays low or you feel short of breath.

headline: Blood oxygen is below the usual range.

suggested_actions.text: Recheck with a different sensor if available.
Rest and breathe slowly.

contact_ground_text: Contact ground soon to report the reading and symptoms.

headline: Blood oxygen is very low.

suggested_actions.text: Contact ground immediately if the link is available.
Recheck with the sensor at rest.

contact_ground_text: Contact ground now, or as soon as the communications link allows. In a blackout, log it and add to the relay summary.

headline: Blood oxygen has been trending down.

suggested_actions.text: Check the sensor and recheck at rest.
Track readings at the same time each day.

contact_ground_text: Contact ground to review the trend, or add it to the relay summary during a blackout.
